source.author: verg
source.text: Haec Damon: vos, quae responderit Alphesiboeus, dicite, Pierides; non omnia possumus omnes.
source.text_original: Haec Damon: vos, quae responderit Alphesiboeus, / dicite, Pierides; non omnia possumus omnes.
source.text_english: Thus Damon spoke: tell, O Pierides, what Alphesiboeus replied; not all of us can do everything.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: not all of us can do all things.
